scope: Public HG002 chr20 only; GIAB v4.2.1 small-variant benchmark, independent of the v5.0q structural benchmark
comparator: RTG Tools 3.13, installed core version c27844a5bb
filter_policy: Native default: FILTER is PASS or dot. No additional quality filter. All eligible called sequence alleles must have finite nonnegative QUAL so the fixed threshold 0 includes all.
region_policy: Full chr20 VCF context and --region chr20; official chr20 BED via --evaluation-regions permits boundary matching. Do not preclip VCF records to BED.
metrics_policy: Count raw TP baseline, TP calls, FP and FN VCF records independently; report baseline recall and call precision separately, including representation differences. Reconcile overall counts with native fixed-score summary. Do not select maximum F-measure.
publisher_integrity_note: Primary VCF, index and BED downloaded over HTTPS with HTTP length checks and recorded local SHA256/MD5. NIST md5.in lists the README and supplementary files, not these primary inputs. The primary file hashes are local pins, not publisher checksum verification.
limits: Single prealigned public chromosome, not the child's alignment or clinical sensitivity
Benchmark confident regions exclude important difficult and structural regions
GIAB truth integrates multiple technologies and callers, including GATK-related methods; this is not a wholly technology-independent test
Diploid genotype agreement is not family phase validation or causal probability
No threshold optimization or changes to the running patient workflow
